summary: DirectBooking Technology Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the appointment of Mr. Zhu Xincheng, an independent director, as chairperson of the compensation committee and as a member of the audit committee and nominating and corporate governance committee, effective April 29, 2026. The appointment appears routine and does not involve a forced or abrupt departure. No meeting notice or proxy circular is included. Given the routine nature, this is classified as Management Changes with low confidence, though it may be considered None.
